item.title: [Moyen] COLDCARD wallet RNG flaw likely linked to $88 million Bitcoin theft
item.description: A vulnerability in COLDCARD hardware wallet firmware allowed attackers to steal an estimated $88.6 million in Bitcoin from thousands of wallets whose seeds were generated using a flawed random number generator. [...]
